CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Duration__c), 0, VALUE( LEFT( SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m",""), FIND( ":", SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m","") ) - 1 ) ) * 60 + VALUE( RIGHT( SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m",""), LEN( SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m","") ) - FIND( ":", SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(LOWER(TRIM(Duration__c))," ",""),"h",":"),"m","") ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Duration Minutes Formula
